title: Fleet TCP connections have no pre-authentication deadline
wanted_capability: Bound the time an unauthenticated TCP peer can retain a fleetd connection through TLS, protocol negotiation and the first authentication envelope.
fallback_used: Keep the existing restricted transport until the separately authorized cutover; no service mutation during hygiene.
notes: Static audit confirms TLS accept, bro_rpc::accept and first read_body are awaited without a server-side deadline. No load test or exposure claim. Other connections continue to be served.
